en: I can teach you the finer points of Raptor Riding, provided you have enough gold to cover the lesson!
I cannot be teachin' a Tauren to ride a Raptor.
You need to be exalted with the trolls of the Darkspear tribe before I will teach you a riding skill, adventurer.

And a good day to ya, brave adventurer. I know ya be lookin' for a fine steed. There's no finer steed than a raptor under your reigns, lemme tell you mon! Take a look at the ones I got to offer - bred from the fiercest stock anywhere.

I'm sorry mon, but I won't be sellin' my raptors to someone who hasn't proven themselves to be exalted to the Darkspear tribe. When ya make a stand and show yourself to be no less than exalted to us, then I'll make my raptors available to ya.
